description: Had been laughed with as Mercutio, and then, very suddenly, not.
name: Augustine Phillips

description: Sat upright in the church hat.
name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

description: Counted twelve pound thirteen, stated forty shillings, and would not divide them.
name: John Heminges

description: Reported the gallery and the church hat, and kept no clever line.
name: Goodwife Margery Pell

description: Said he had held under the note, and asked for no further proof.
name: Nick Sorrell

description: Said the five words had been enough, and went toward sleep.
name: Richard Burbage

description: Counted his three stops, and did not count the box.
name: Thomas Pope

description: Claimed one line more, and left the slate empty.
name: Will Kemp

description: Named the October house, refused a third figure, and took the share.
name: William Shakespeare
